periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees downward toward the medial axis of the snout relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering effect, with the patch extending significantly further below the ocular center than above it.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curvature across the posterior edge of the scapular band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band occupies approximately 25-30% of the visible dorsal-to-ventral torso span.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The gap between the medial edges of the ears is approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semi-circular curvature at the superior boundary of both pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Exposed mandibular dentition including canines and incisors; localized yellowish tinting on the posterior-lateral white pelage.
